title.zh: 卷九十八 志第七十四 藝文三
title.raw: 卷九十八 志第七十四 藝文三 Volume 98 Treatises 74: Arts and Literature 3

sentences.zh: 子類十二：一曰儒家類，二曰雜家類，前代藝文志列名法諸家，然寥寥無幾，備數而已。

translations.literal: The Masters category has twelve divisions: first, Confucianists; second, eclectics. Bibliographies of arts and letters in earlier dynasties also listed the Legalists and other schools, yet there were only a handful—entered merely to round out the count.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters section comprises twelve types, beginning with Confucian and eclectic works. Earlier dynasty bibliographies included Legalist and related schools as well, but those holdings were negligible—counted only to complete the tally.

translations.literal: Now they are all subsumed under the eclectics.
translations.idiomatic: They are now all grouped under the miscellaneous-schools category.

sentences.zh: 三曰農家類，四曰小說家類，五曰兵書類，六曰天文類，七曰歷數類，八曰五行類，九曰藝術類，醫書附。

translations.literal: Third, agriculturists; fourth, fictionists; fifth, military books; sixth, astronomy; seventh, calendrics; eighth, Five Phases; ninth, arts—with medical books appended.
translations.idiomatic: Next come farming texts, fiction, military treatises, astronomy, calendrical studies, Five-Phase works, and the arts category, with medical books included at the end.

sentences.zh: 十曰類書類，十一曰道家類，十二曰釋家類。

translations.literal: Tenth, encyclopedias; eleventh, Daoists; twelfth, Buddhists.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth are encyclopedias, eleventh Daoist writings, and twelfth Buddhist works.

translations.idiomatic: *Heart-Methods of Sage Learning*, four volumes, was compiled in the Yongle era and arranged in four parts: the ruler's way, the minister's way, the father's way, and the son's way.

translations.idiomatic: The Yongle Emperor wrote its preface.
